task.question: How many of the 203 dependency-upgrade tasks did the best coding-agent configuration solve on DEPBENCH?
task.evidence: We evaluate mainstream coding agents on DEPBENCH. The best completed configuration solves only 104/203 tasks (51.2%), with substantial variation across agent harnesses, models, and ecosystems, highlighting an important gap between current agent capabilities and real-world software maintenance needs.

answer:
The best coding-agent configuration on DEPBENCH solved 151 of the 203 dependency-upgrade tasks.

FINAL: 151
